assessments.finding: The closest competitor by name. 'Segmented' here means AXIAL duct spacing (0-20 mm gaps between duct sections along the axis) studied by CFD (k-omega SST + broadband noise model) at 20,000-40,000 rpm; the paper reports acoustic power rising with spacing and recommends <=10 mm. It is not circumferential seams at equal mean radial clearance, it is simulation only with no measurement, the geometry is fixed (no deployment), and the abstract states it cannot resolve transients. It must be cited and distinguished explicitly: same word, different geometry.
